text: City Council on June 25 and 26, 2025, adopted Item EX24.5 and, in so doing, has requested the Board of Directors of CreateTO to direct the Chief Executive Officer, CreateTO to act as the executive lead to coordinate the management of City-owned dock walls.
The Board of Directors of CreateTO: 1. Directed the Chief Executive Officer, CreateTO to act as the executive lead to coordinate the management of City-owned dock walls.
